title: Try the longer estimate
hook: A task estimated at fifteen to twenty-five minutes needs more than one calendar test.

doesNotKnow: Stress-test a schedule at the longer end of an explicit range.

recall.question: A task takes 20 to 35 minutes. You start at 13:00 and have a fixed call at 13:30. What does checking the longer estimate show?
options: It fits with 10 minutes to spare
It may run 5 minutes into the call
recall.why: At the upper end 13:00 + 35 minutes = 13:35, past the 13:30 call; the short estimate hides that.
